subject.title: fix(auth): prioritize explicit models.json apiKey over store profiles

question: Should literal and SecretRef `models.providers.<id>.apiKey` values outrank stored auth profiles by default when `auth: "api-key"` is not set?
rationale: Current docs and current-main resolver/status behavior document profile-first precedence, while this PR changes credential selection for existing configs and cannot be accepted as a bug fix without maintainer policy approval.

options.title: Keep profile-first default
options.body: Require the PR to preserve stored profiles as the default winner and use the existing explicit `auth: "api-key"` path for config-first behavior.

options.title: Adopt explicit-key-first default
options.body: Approve the compatibility change only after the PR updates docs, status output, tests, upgrade proof, and real agent-runtime proof for the new order.

options.title: Narrow to mechanical fixes
options.body: Pause the precedence change and land only marker/type/status fixes that match the current profile-first contract.

recommendation.title: Keep profile-first default
recommendation.body: Require the PR to preserve stored profiles as the default winner and use the existing explicit `auth: "api-key"` path for config-first behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He has recent documented-auth and provider-helper history in the affected area and is a plausible owner for the product-facing precedence decision.
